title: Staffing a core-banking programme on deadline
challenge: A banking-technology services firm won a FLEXCUBE implementation and needed functional and technical consultants before mobilisation.
approach: Mapped consultants with hands-on module history, pre-screened for notice period and project fit, and ran panel days in batches.
result: Twelve consultants joined within five weeks; the programme mobilised on schedule.

title: A confidential CFO replacement
challenge: A mid-size services group needed to replace its CFO without signalling the change to staff or the market.
approach: Direct headhunting only — no postings — against a board-agreed scorecard, with client identity revealed only at final stages.
result: Shortlist of four in five weeks; the selected CFO joined after a managed counter-offer.

title: Opening a new production line
challenge: A manufacturer commissioning a new line needed operators, supervisors and quality staff in a single wave.
approach: Local sourcing drives, structured skill checks on site and background verification before offer.
result: Forty hires in place ahead of commissioning, with verification complete for every joiner.

title: Becoming the TA team for a scaling IT firm
challenge: A growing IT services company had no in-house recruiters and inconsistent hiring across teams.
approach: Embedded recruiters under the client's brand, a shared pipeline dashboard and weekly hiring-manager syncs.
result: A predictable run-rate of around eighteen hires a quarter and a single, consistent interview process.

title: A digital-banking leader for the Gulf
challenge: A mid-size private bank expanding in the UAE needed a leader with OBDX-era digital-channel experience.
approach: Talent mapped across India and the GCC through our Dubai office, with relocation and compensation benchmarking up front.
result: Three assessed finalists; the appointed leader relocated and started within the quarter.

title: Scaling for a seasonal peak
challenge: A logistics operator needed warehouse and fleet staff across three cities for a fixed peak window.
approach: An on-site RPO pod ran daily hiring drives, with flexible staffing contracts for short-term roles.
result: Peak headcount reached before the window opened, with roles released cleanly afterwards.
